result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, data return within 30 days in a commonly used machine-readable format, and written certification of deletion thereafter. The addition is targeted and does not alter unrelated termination economics or renewal rights. Minor drafting issues remain: “Termination Date” may not be defined for every expiration or termination scenario, and Section 4.3 is not expressly added to the survival clause, although its post-termination wording supports continued enforceability.
